'''Marianne the Vault scholar''' is a resident of [[Vault 33]] {{In|FOTV}}.

==Background==
Marianne is a scholarly individual who resides in Vault 33.

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===Season 1===
====[[The Head]]====
Sitting at her desk, Marianne unlocks the door from her computer for [[Norm MacLean|Norm]], who delivers a tray of food for the [[Vault 32 raider]]s. As Marianne opens the door hatch to the raider's room, she passes the trays of food to them all while trying to be polite to them all. 

When a conference is held led by the Vault 33 governing council members [[Woody Thomas|Woody]], [[Reg McPhee|Reg]], and [[Betty Pearson|Betty]]. The topic of the discussion is what to do with the Vault 32 raiders and when it's decided to integrate them into their society. When [[Davey (TV series)|Davey]] suggests teaching the Vault 32 raiders [[William Shakespeare|Shakespeare]] and when they're ready, [[Christopher Marlowe|Marlowe]]. However, Marianne cuts in, stating that Shakespeare is too advanced for them, and suggests starting with a more moral framework with [[Immanuel Kant|Kant]], [[John Stuart Mill|Mill]], etc.

After a couple more suggestions are tossed out, Norm scoffs and Reg asks him if he has a suggestion, which he notes that it's not their obligation to help them. On the other hand, one [[Vault 33 dweller]] claims that they didn't know any better, while Marriane concurs, stating they don't have a formal education. Still, Norm suggests killing them all in retribution for what they did to them all, which earns him a disapproving reaction from the Vault 33 dwellers and council, causing Betty to mediate the situation as best as she can.

Just then, the [[Vault 33 engineer]] arrives and wants to say something to the council in private, but Reg insists he formally announces it to everyone. As it turns out, he notes that the [[Water chip (TV series)|water chip]] was destroyed, and they likely have less than two months' worth of water.

Once that was revealed, Marianne and the other Vault 33 dwellers headed off.

====[[The Past]]====
[[File:Vault 33 election.png|thumb|right|200px]]

On the day to vote for a new Vault 33 overseer, Marianne is seen passing out election ballots to the Vault 33 dwellers.

Afterward, once all of the votes are tallied, Marianne gives a formal announcement stating that 98% of the people had elected Betty as their new overseer. Marianne stands by as Betty gives a speech where she thanks everyone there and slices up the jelly cake for them all.

The next day, Marianne partakes in viewing [[Vault 32]], and learns from Betty that many of the residents of Vault 33 will be transferred over to Vault 32.
